'''[[Pablo/Legends|Pablo's]] Twi'lek partner''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who helped the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] Pablo in his [[Pablo's pawnshop/Legends|pawnshop]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], in the capital city [[Bilbousa/Legends|Bilbousa]].

==Biography==
After the escaped prisoner [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] along with [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], disguised as [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]], came into Pablo's shop and threatened him, this Twi'lek warned the [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|local authorities]] which pursued the prisoners back to their starship.
